market.question: Will the minimum Arctic sea ice extent this summer be less than 4m square kilometers?

assessment.reasoning: 2025 minimum was 4.60M sq km. Historical sub-4M years are rare (2012 = 3.39M, 2020 = 3.74M); only ~3-4 of last 20 years went below 4M. April 2026 ice extent is at near-record low and modeled ice volume is at record low for late April, which raises the odds, but spring extent has weak correlation with September minimum. Combining base rate (~20%) with bullish 2026 indicators gives moderate but sub-50% probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Summer atmospheric pattern (cyclones, persistent high pressure) which dominates September minimum
